title: Radio: Crew 3 — RTU-01 Cabinet Door Ajar

fields.orgName: City of Millbrook Department of Water & Sewer

lines.text: Dispatch, this is Crew 3 on Route 22. We're at the Eastfield Pump Station and found the RTU-05 cabinet door ajar — no visible damage, but the lock is bent. The HMI shows no alarm, and the RTU is online. We've secured the area and are waiting for the SCADA team to confirm if it's a physical tamper or a false alarm. Should we open it?

Crew 3, confirm the RTU-05 cabinet door tamper switch status in the log. If it's not tripped, and no alarm was generated, it may be a false alarm. Do not open the cabinet. Wait for the SCADA / IT Security Manager to authorize entry. Report to the Security Officer for chain-of-custody.

instructorNote: Noise inject; the technical team should verify the tamper switch status in the log before responding. Watch for any attempt to bypass protocol or open the cabinet.
